title: Record external handoff
purpose: Record a completed transfer of selected containers for one requested test to an actual external laboratory, preserving the internal sample’s separate location and custody.
summary: Record that containers for one requested test were handed to an external laboratory. The sample's own location and custody are not changed.

tasks.title: Record the handoff
steps: Enter the [[External laboratory]] and the [[External order / dispatch reference]].
Enter when it happened in [[Completed handoff at]] and the [[Receiving custodian / courier]].
Tick the [[Containers handed over]], give the [[Reason]] and select [[Record external handoff]].

tasks.title: Add the external sample ID later
steps: Leave [[External sample ID]] blank if it is not assigned yet. Enter it with the source result.

good_to_know: Record a handoff that has happened. A planned shipment is not enough.
A test already in a batch, with any result history or with preparation cannot be sent out.
Held, rejected or disposed samples cannot be sent out, and each test can have only one active subcontract.

items.label: Sample / Analyte / Client
items.description: Identifies the received sample and requested test. Container choices belong only to this sample; sending one test does not send every test or container.

items.label: External laboratory
items.description: Required actual laboratory name, up to 160 characters; no external-laboratory registry is inferred.

items.label: External order / dispatch reference
items.description: Required actual arrangement/reference, up to 160 characters.

items.label: External sample ID
items.description: Optional ID if already assigned, up to 160 characters. If unknown, supply the actual ID with the source result.

items.label: Completed handoff at
items.description: Required actual timestamp, initially now, in laboratory local time. Must be at or after latest custody and not in the future; planned shipment is insufficient.

items.label: Containers handed over
items.description: Required one or more checkboxes, each labeled with container label, description and receipt condition. Select only physical containers included; foreign sample containers are refused.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required dispatch explanation, at most 4000 characters.

sections.title: Eligibility and actions
paragraphs: Held, rejected or physically disposed samples cannot dispatch. Only one active subcontract is allowed per requested test. Internal batch assignment, any result history, or recorded preparation for this test blocks external routing, even if prepared work later closes/cancels. An empty awaiting result with no batch/history does not itself block dispatch. Eligibility and sample revision are rechecked atomically; a concurrent change requires reloading custody first. The whole sample’s current location and custody events are not changed by this selected-container handoff.

items.label: Record external handoff
items.description: Custodians, project managers and administrators save generated EXT routing, selected-container snapshots, origin location, actor/time and audit, then open the subcontract.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the sample without recording a handoff.
